text:
Alex L: FYI we have a growing backlog of reserved GPU requests in us-west-2. queue length is 26 and median lead time is 18d.
Maya P: Oof. Is that from new Dedicated commits or Private deployment requests?
Alex L: Mostly Dedicated reserved capacity for Q3 customer rollouts + a few private on-prem appliance orders.
Jordan (SRE): I started digging; some requests are stuck in 'provisioning' because the cloud provider hasn't confirmed instance placements. There's a billing hold on a handful of CCs too.
Sophia O: @Ian (Finance) any idea about the billing holds? Those will block our ability to convert reservations.
Ian (Finance): Seeing a small spike in declined charge attempts for multi-month commitments — card issuer flags on high-authority transactions. Reached out to customers for AM confirmation.
capacity-bot: Ticket #CR-4127 created for capacity queue alert (length > 20). Owners: eng-platform oncall.
Maya P: Can we short-circuit low-risk requests? e.g., accept day-1 burst on spot/backfill while reservation clears? Need policy check.
Jordan (SRE): Technically yes. We can offer temporary burst on flexible pods (spot/preemptible) with a transparent note about performance and SLA differences. Requires consent from customer and a billing marker so they don't get charged reservation rates.
Alex L: OK let's propose a "temp-burst" flag on the request form that sets these defaults: spot-backfill, no SLA, pro-rated pricing. We should also add an expirary of 14 days.
Maya P: +1. That will reduce queue pressure. Also suggest a priority re-score: rollouts with signed contracts > 30d get higher priority.
Sophia O: Agree on priority. Also we should fix the provisioning race where reservations are created but not bound to instances due to a cloud API change (noticed last week). I can open an infra bug.
Jordan (SRE): Please do. In the meantime, I can run a manual reconcile script to find unbound reservations and re-request placements. Estimated runtime ~ 45m and will patch 8 stuck requests.
Alex L: Great — run it and post the log. Also we need a list of customers affected so CSMs can set expectations.
Ian (Finance): I'll whitelist our payment flows for the specific merchants flagged and contact the customers with next steps. ETA EOD.
capacity-bot: Reconcile job queued by Jordan (SRE) — job id rc-20260318-01.
Maya P: For comms: public-facing: "short-term burst available, reservation lead times ~2-3 weeks". Internal: proactive outreach for customers in the backlog >10d.
Sophia O: I'll create a simple dashboard widget in Console: 'pending reservations by region' and a heatmap for lead time. That will help ops prioritize.
Jordan (SRE): Ran the reconcile — logs: `rc-20260318-01`: matched 8 reservations with pending placement, re-requested placements for 6, 2 failed (billing hold). Pushing details to the ticket.
Alex L: Nice. Can we also add an automated escalation rule: if request age > 10d -> ping eng-platform + csm + finance?
Maya P: Yes, add triage levels: P0 (customer facing launch, SLA required), P1 (contracted but flexible), P2 (internal experiments/trials). Escalation timeline 72h/7d/14d.
Ian (Finance): For the two failed ones, I have the customers on the phone. If we get payment confirmation within 24h we can convert. Otherwise we'll recommend temp-burst.
Sophia O: I'll put the infra bug PR in the pipeline: change is small, adding retry backoff to cloud-alloc calls. Link: https://git.redwood/sk/infra/pull/789
Alex L: Summary action items: 1) Jordan run reconcile (done) + attach logs to CR-4127, 2) Sophia open infra PR (link above), 3) Maya update request form + add temp-burst flag, 4) Ian contact affected customers and clear billing holds, 5) Sophia add dashboard widget.
Jordan (SRE): Marking ticket CR-4127 -> in-progress. I'll follow up if reconcile fixes more than 6.
Maya P: I'll draft the customer note for temp-burst and share in #support for legal + pricing signoff.
Ian (Finance): If anyone needs immediate fund validation, tell customers to upload PO or call our payments team — faster than waiting for card auth fixes.
Alex L: Thanks all. If we don't see queue shrink by 48h we'll escalate to execs for an emergency capacity buy (short-term reserved instances) — flagging @sre-lead.
capacity-bot: Note added to CR-4127: escalations threshold: queue length > 25 && median lead > 10d.
Sophia O: Updated dashboard PR: https://git.redwood/sk/console/pull/402 — should show by tomorrow.
Maya P: I'll post the short-term comms in #customer-success after legal thumbs up.
Jordan (SRE): Closing loop: reconcile reduced queue to 18. Still 4 stuck (billing). Will re-run in 12h.
Alex L: Great progress. Keep updates short here. :thumbsup:
